title: Observability: token/KV cost & latency dashboards, tracing enhancements, alert tuning
author: Maya Chen
description: Context: We need clearer token-level cost/latency and KV-cache visibility to diagnose regressions and optimize routing/pinning policies. This PR adds improved token/KV cost and latency dashboards, stronger tracing annotations for token-level flows, and alert tuning for noisy signals so on-call noise is reduced while preserving detection sensitivity. Changes: 1) New Grafana dashboards that break down per-request token cost, per-token latency percentiles, KV cache hit/miss rates and cost impact by model variant and route. 2) Tracing: instrumentation added to tokenization, KV cache lookup/insert, and model inference hot paths; spans include token counts, kv_hit boolean, quantization profile, and model_variant tags. 3) Metrics: new Prometheus metrics rwi_token_cost_total, rwi_token_latency_seconds_bucket by route/model_variant, rwi_kv_hit_total and rwi_kv_miss_total with cardinality controls. 4) Alert tuning: updated alert rules to use aggregated 5m windows, group by service/region and include suppression when maintenance label is set; thresholds adjusted after one week of traffic analysis. 5) Docs and runbook updates: dashboards.md, alert-runbook.md and rollout notes. Motivation: recent incident (SUP-998) showed regressions caused by unseen KV miss storms and noisy alerts; this PR targets observable signals that would have surfaced the regression earlier and reduces pager fatigue. Testing: unit tests for new metrics exporter, integration test that simulates KV miss spike and verifies dashboard metrics and alerts, and manual verification on staging with synthetic traffic. Rollout: feature gated behind env flag OBS_TOKEN_KV_V1, staged rollout to dedicated region then global. Checklist: [x] Metrics exports added and tested; [x] Tracing spans added and validated in staging; [x] Dashboards reviewed with SRE; [x] Alert thresholds tuned and simulated; [x] Docs and runbook updated. Backwards compatibility: metrics added are additive and tracing tags are non-breaking. Release notes: see release_notes field below.
